correctness.rationale: The smooth Kummer cover and tame involution give three invariant differentials. The exact hyperelliptic binomial coefficient formula has nonzero support determined by multiplication by p modulo fourteen; six explicit residue cases prove all Cartier rank powers. Direct exact modular Cartier matrix ranks for 38 primes and exact Laurent-polynomial quotient identity agree. The p>13 automorphism restriction matches the earlier cited classification.

Garcia–Tafazolian Theorem 3.3 proves C^n=0 on any curve maximal over F_(p^(2n)); with n=1 and the 2019 maximality criterion it proves C=0 in the congruence class p=13 mod14.
2018 Kazemifard–Tafazolian–Torres develops Chebyshev/Kummer maximal curves, not the present all-prime Cartier rank table.
For residues 3 and 5 mod 14, cubing the residue gives -1 mod 14; hence 2019 maximality over F_(p^6) and the 2008 Cartier theorem imply C^3=0, but not ranks C or C^2.
For residues 9 and 11 mod 14 the generated residue subgroup is {1,9,11} and no positive power is -1 modulo 14, so the 2019 maximality route cannot supply C^2=0.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A key special case IS covered: the p=13 mod 14 Cartier-zero row follows already from 2019 maximality plus 2008 general Cartier vanishing, and its minimal automorphism corollary follows with the 2026 result. Those are explicitly acknowledged as prior. Neither theorem covers the distinct nonmaximal residue rank-power chains, whose calculation is the surviving contribution. The p=3,5 mod14 nilpotence at exponent 3 is likewise already a corollary of 2019 and 2008, but its exact intermediate ranks are not. For p=9,11 mod14 the nilpotence exponent 2 is entirely beyond this maximality implication.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Earlier papers already imply the maximal prime superspeciality and the automorphism corollary. However their hypotheses do not apply to p=1,3,5,9,11 mod14 nonmaximal reduction, and do not determine those exact Cartier ranks. The accepted novel scope is the complete table with explicitly identified pre-existing row and the two different nonmaximal nilpotent profiles. In detail, p=3 or 5 mod14 gives p^3=-1 mod14 and pre-existing C^3=0, while the intermediate ranks 2 and 1 remain unforced; p=9 or 11 yields no power -1 mod14, and the rank-one square-zero case is outside the published maximality implication.

originality.rationale: The 2019 Tafazolian–Top theorem already studies the exact Dickson quotient, and its maximality condition together with Garcia–Tafazolian (2008) Theorem 3.3 implies the p=13 mod 14 zero-Cartier row. That row, and its combination with the 2026 automorphism classification, are not new. The full classification, especially exact Cartier rank-power chains for the four nonmaximal residue classes p=3,5,9,11 mod14, is not stated or implied by those maximality results. Related Novoselov, 2018 and 2025 Chebyshev literature was compared; the 2025 PDF remains inaccessible.

value.rationale: Natural complete residue-class classification of the characteristic-wise Cartier rank sequences for a fixed genus-three Dickson curve. In the nonmaximal classes p=3,5,9,11 mod14 the two different nonzero nilpotent Jordan types are not determined by prior maximality or zeta-function theorems. The superspecial maximal row and automorphism corollary are explicitly marked as pre-existing implications, not the claimed advance.
